name_reason: Conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=engine). Descriptor 'wait_n_bios_ticks_last_seen' accurately names a cached scalar (the last-seen BIOS tick) serving fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks. The 'n' is the served function's parameter name (n_ticks), not a Ghidra address residue; no hex of 0x53a2c (or any address) appears in the name. Correctly distinguishes the sibling data_fd2_engine_wait_one_bios_tick_last_seen. Reflects data nature (mutable latch/cache scalar).
purpose: Private frame-pacer cache holding the last-observed BIOS midnight tick (0:046C, 18.2 Hz) for fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks.
logic_summary: On entry fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks snapshots the current BIOS tick into this scalar, busy-spins until the live tick has advanced by at least n_ticks (16-bit wrap handled), then re-stores the current tick so the next call counts from the latest reference (~55 ms per tick). The value is the SIGN-EXTENDED 16-bit tick stored as a full 32-bit dword (asm: MOVSX EAX,word ptr [0x46C]; MOV [0x53A2C],EAX at 0x17abf/0x17ae7; SUB EAX,dword ptr [0x53A2C] at 0x17acc), so a low word of 0xFFFF caches as 0xFFFFFFFF. Sole accessor is fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks (xrefs: WRITE 0x17abf, READ 0x17acc, WRITE 0x17ae7).
element_semantics: Single 32-bit scalar = the last-seen BIOS midnight-tick value, sign-extended from the 16-bit word at 0:046C and stored/compared as a dword. Not an array.
notes: Source comment block (input.c lines 718-731) was already accurate, precise, and ASCII; matches disassembly exactly, including the documented Ghidra 'tick - tick' decompiler artifact and the sign-extend caching detail, so no src edit (comment_verdict=keep) -> no input.c diff. Ghidra data plate at 0x53a2c was empty (PLATE_COMMENT null); created a concise plate via run_script_inline (cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)) reflecting the src conclusion, then persisted with save_program (success). is_const=false: it is a mutable runtime cache (two game-side WRITEs by its owning function); zero-init BSS. Name kept; rename not applicable. Staged scope = this shard only (input.c untouched); two other modified shards in the tree belong to concurrent refiners and were not staged.
